sources.role: Z64K.jar reviewed by listing, class-string survey and headless boot observation

paths.path: User-saved configuration at a user-chosen path via the Swing file chooser; no fixed host file
paths.naming: A clean headless boot writes nothing to HOME or cwd; persistence is explicit user save only.
evidence: runtime:java -jar Z64K.jar c64 headless boot writes no HOME/cwd files

paths.path: jamepad hot-plug gamepads plus the keyboard configuration editor (keyboard/default.kb resource)
paths.naming: Gamepads enumerate at boot (GAMEPAD CONNECTED); keyboard map is positional with editor overrides.
evidence: runtime:java -jar Z64K.jar c64 GAMEPAD CONNECTED boot log

paths.path: Mounted media images are written back to their own user-chosen paths; no fixed SRAM sidecar grammar
paths.naming: No emulator-owned save directory; persistence lives with the user-located content.
evidence: runtime:java -jar Z64K.jar c64 headless boot writes no HOME/cwd files

paths.path: User-chosen snapshot files (.zsf) via -snapshot <path> or the file chooser
paths.naming: Snapshot restore takes an explicit user path; no slot directory.

paths.path: Bundled in-jar system ROMs (c64/basic.rom, kernal.rom, chargen.rom, palettes, SID waveforms); no user firmware path
paths.naming: ROMs load from the jar (c64/cram.bin, palette/vicii/, sid/wave*) at boot.
evidence: runtime:java -jar Z64K.jar c64 boot ROM/palette/waveform log

paths.path: No external cryptographic key material required
paths.naming: Class-string survey found no key store or key-file references.
